<div class="no-box" id="p_lt_ctl03_SharedContent_pnlShared3">
<p><strong>New Legislative Summary for Board Members Available</strong><br/>
TASB Legal Services has finalized the 2019 Legislative Summary for Board Members. This free document contains summaires of bills that the 86th Legislature passed during the legislative session. <a href="/legislative/documents/2019-lege-summary-members.pdf" target="_blank">View the document.</a></p>
<p><strong>NSBA Advocacy Institute Stipend Application is now live</strong><br/>
TASB is now accepting applications from school board members interested in earning a stipend to attend the National School Boards Association Advocacy Institute in Washington, DC, scheduled for Feb. 2–4, 2020. <a href="/legislative/events/nsba-advocacy-institute.aspx" target="_self">Learn more.</a></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="tab-pane" id="tabedu" role="tabpanel">
<div class="no-box" id="p_lt_ctl04_SharedContent1_pnlShared3">
<p><strong>October 23, 2019</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.texastribune.org/2019/10/22/Dennis-Bonnen-to-not-seek-reelection-to-Texas-House/" target="_blank"><font color="#0066cc">Texas House Speaker Dennis Bonnen won't seek reelection after recording scandal</font></a>, Texas Tribune</li>
<li><a href="https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/2019/10/21/the-uil-is-on-the-verge-of-adding-a-new-sport-for-the-first-time-in-more-than-20-years/" target="_blank"><font color="#0066cc">UIL adds a new sanctioned sport, pending approval, for the first time in more than 20 years</font></a>, CBS DFW</li>
</ul>
<p><a href="https://www.tasb.org/About-TASB/News-and-Media/Daily-News.aspx"><font color="#0066cc">More news...</font></a></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="tab-pane" id="tabpol" role="tabpanel">
<div class="no-box" id="p_lt_ctl05_SharedContent2_pnlShared3">
<div style="line-height:18px;">
<p><strong>Available in the <a href="/Services/Policy-Service/myTASB/Home.aspx">Policy Service Resource Library</a>:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Update 60 to the <em><a href="/Services/Policy-Service/myTASB/Regulations-Resource-Manual.aspx" title="Regulations Resource Manual">Regulations Resource Manual</a> </em>which includes revisions to model regulations and forms corresponding with Update 114.</li>
<li><a href="/services/policy-service/mytasb/policy-manual-update-resources.aspx">Policy Manual Update Resources</a> for Update 114.</li>
<li><a href="/services/policy-service/resources/update-preview.aspx" title="Update Preview">Update 114 Preview</a> includes a list of local policies to address most of the legislative changes from the 86th Legislative Session.</li>
<li>Revisions to <a href="https://www.tasb.org/services/policy-service/resources/student-discipline.aspx" title="Chapter 37"><em>Education Code Chapter 37, Subchapter A</em></a> from the 86th Legislature and the revised <a href="https://www.tasb.org/Services/Legal-Services/TASB-School-Law-eSource/Students/documents/chapter_37_chart.aspx" title="Chapter 37 Chart">Chapter 37 Offenses and Consequences Chart</a>.</li>
<li>The 2019 <em><a href="/Services/Policy-Service/myTASB/Model-Student-Code-of-Conduct.aspx" title="Model Student Code of Conduct">Model Student Code of Conduct</a> </em>which helps districts oganize provisions of the law that communicates what is expected of students and how misconduct will be handled.</li>
<li>The post-legislative supplement to the 2019–20 <em><a href="/Services/Policy-Service/myTASB/Model-Student-Handbook.aspx" title="Model Student Handbook">Model Student Handbook</a> </em>which helps districts communicate essential information to students and parents.</li>
</ul>
<p>Visit our <a href="/services/policy-service/frequently-asked-questions-faqs.aspx" title="Frequently Asked Questions">Frequently Asked Questions</a> or call us at 800.580.7529 if you have any questions.</p>
<p><strong>Coming soon:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Districts will begin receiving Update 114 packets in <strong>late October</strong>.</li>
<li>Revisions to TASB Legal Services' <a href="/services/policy-service/mytasb/legal-tips.aspx">Legal Tips</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p>For more, see Policy Service’s <a href="/services/policy-service/publication-information.aspx">Public Information</a> page...</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="tab-pane" id="tablegal" role="tabpanel">
<div class="no-box" id="p_lt_ctl06_LegalShared_pnlShared3">
<ul>
<li>TASB Legal Services' <a href="/services/legal-services/tasb-school-law-esource/governance/documents/nov_trustee_election.pdf" target="_blank">Deadlines for November 5, 2019 School District Trustee Elections</a> (pdf) provides important dates and deadlines applicable to school districts preparing for the November 5, 2019 trustee election.</li>
<li>TASB Legal Services' <a href="/services/legal-services/tasb-school-law-esource/governance/documents/hb2840-public-comment-and-testimony-at-board-meetings.pdf" target="_blank">HB 2840 - Public Comment and Testimony at Board Meetings</a> (pdf) provides basic information about House Bill 2840, effective September 1, 2019, that affects how school boards must address public comments from citizens during board meetings.</li>
<li>TASB Legal Services' article <a href="/Services/Legal-Services/TASB-School-Law-eSource/Community/documents/visitors-to-school-property-and-school-events.pdf" target="_blank">Visitors to School Property and School Events</a> (pdf) provides guidance related to school visitors, including visitor screening, sex offenders, prohibited activities, and excluding disruptive parents and others from school property or school events.</li>
<li>TASB Legal Services' document <a href="/Services/Legal-Services/TASB-School-Law-eSource/Personnel/documents/guidelines-for-responding-to-allegations-of-educat.pdf" target="_blank">Guidelines for Responding to Allegations of Educator Misconduct</a> (pdf) was developed in collaboration with representatives from school districts, law enforcement, TEA, SBEC, the Texas Department of Family Protective Services, and other entities. The Guidelines provide considerations for school districts to develop plans with local authorities for responding to allegations of sexual harassment, improper relationships, and child abuse.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="tab-pane" id="tabhr" role="tabpanel">
<div class="no-box">
<p><strong><a href="/services/hr-services/hrx/recruiting-and-hiring/retirees-and-alternative-hiring-arrangements.aspx">Retirees and Alternative Hiring Arrangements</a></strong><br/>
Districts tempted to hire a retiree through a third-party entity or as an independent contractor to avoid surcharges and annuity payment reductions should proceed with caution.

</p>
<p><strong><a href="/services/hr-services/hrx/compensation-and-benefits/sick-leave-bank-vs-pool-what-s-the-difference.aspx">Sick Leave Bank vs. Pool: What’s the Difference?</a></strong><br/>
Employers may choose to establish leave donation programs to assist employees who exhaust their paid leave because of an extended, catastrophic illness or injury.

</p>
<p><strong><a href="/services/hr-services/hrx/other-hr/darktober-strategies-for-helping-staff-cope.aspx">Darktober: Strategies for Helping Staff Cope</a></strong><br/>
I’m not sure where the term Darktober first got its start, but it’s an epidemic felt in education, particularly by new teachers.

</p>
<p><a href="https://www.tasb.org/Services/HR-Services/HRX/Home.aspx">Read all HRX articles</a></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="tab-pane" id="tabess" role="tabpanel">
<div class="no-box" id="p_lt_ctl08_SharedESSTab_pnlShared3">
<p><strong>White Oak ISD Hires Executive Search Services</strong></p>
<p>On October 1, the White Oak ISD Board of Trustees hired TASB Executive Search Services (ESS) to conduct a search for a new superintendent.</p>
<p>Further details about all search activities can be found on the <a href="/Executive-Search-Services.aspx">ESS website</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
